metadata.method_name: Held-out-family (gemma-3-4b-it) confirmation of push-movability as a predictor of ban compliance (C3a), ban-free landing forecasts (C3b) and a descriptive C1 price replication
metadata.description: Curated demo subset of the held-out-family (gemma-3-4b-it) ban-prediction experiment: all 15 task-level events of the dataset heldout_task_events, each enriched with the per-task inputs that the frozen analysis reads (pre-ban commitment, C1 arm label counts, two sample-level A_t variants, example programs). Built by build_mini_demo_data.py.

escape_rule.off_default: label not in {D, invalid, disputed} over all attempts

compliance_rule.A_t: catalogue-only avoidance = #(ban label in catalogue minus {D}) / N_ban (N=100)

c3a_rule.confirmed: BA >= 0.8 AND Fisher two-sided p < 0.05 AND Spearman rho >= 0.5

edge_rules.single_predicted_class: BA = 0.5 ('no discrimination'); disconfirming only if both outcome classes exist
edge_rules.no_confirmed_escape_anywhere: every prediction 'immovable'; C3a untestable as a discriminator; stage-1 off-default shares and PN shares reported as continuous predictors
edge_rules.disputed_labels: never counted as default, off-default or avoidance; fallback labels in a sensitivity
edge_rules.flagged_tasks: R6 (off-catalogue modal default linear_scan; ban names X_q): C3a also reported without it

unit_sensitivity.note: ban-derived unit measured after commit #2; movability is not re-measured; E_t is restated in ban units only (alpha_ban = alpha / ratio)

posthoc_t2_relabel.label: POST HOC: not pre-registered; the frozen primary result stands as committed

reported_results.note: values reported by the experiment (results/*.json), for comparison with the notebook's re-run

E_t_in_ban_units.note: E_t counts directions; restating alpha in ban units relabels the doses only

metadata_example_programs.code:
def solve(nums):
    n = len(nums) - 1
    total_sum = sum(nums)
    expected_sum = n * (n + 1) // 2
    return total_sum - expected_sum
